Key takeaways

What you do well

  • Back leg pushes down, through the gather229lb

    You press more than your own body weight into the ground on most of your swings. That is a real strength. Keep it.

  • Hips between the feet at landing47%

    Centred on every swing, inside the target every time. This is one of the best things you do.

  • Foot down to contact126ms

    Yours takes 126 ms, give or take 11 ms. That is quick, and you do it the same way every time.

What to fix

  • Bat to lead arm, bat straight up24.3°

    Acceleration · Whether the bat and your front arm line up like train tracks when the bat is straight up.

  • Barrel lag, bat flat−0.5in

    Acceleration · When the bat comes flat on the way down, how far the barrel is still behind your hands.

  • Back hip works away from the plate−2.0in

    Contact · Whether your back hip works away from the plate through contact, or chases the ball toward it.
